name: Framsticks
description: Artificial life simulator in which virtual 3D creatures composed of rigid sticks and joints evolve locomotion and morphology through a genetic algorithm. Framsticks supports both manual design and open-ended evolution of embodied agents and has been used to study the co-evolution of body and brain.
reputation: Well-known in the ALife community for enabling study of morphology-controller co-evolution in 3D physical simulation.
notes: Freeware with source available; primarily a research tool. Fitness landscapes are highly multimodal and simulation-dependent.
